name: ChartBrush
description:
An overview strip with a draggable, resizable window that drives a chart's x domain:
pass the same `value` to the charts' `xDomain` to show one range in several charts.
LineChart and AreaChart draw one under the plot with `brush`.
signature: ({ x, series, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, label, domain, formatX, locale: localeProp, className, ...rest }: ChartBrushProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed value range for the strip's line. Defaults to the data's.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format a numeric x for the handles' values.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the strip: "CPU · NST-C106 · overview".

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the handles' values. Default: the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called once per change (on release, or per key), with null for the whole range.

props.name: series
props.description: The series drawn in the strip; the first gets the wash when it is the only one.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled window: null shows the whole range. Leave undefined for uncontrolled.

props.name: x
props.description: The x values of the whole range, ascending: Dates for time, numbers otherwise.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
